name: Create test calendar event in actor calendar
description: test-user-01 creates a short calendar event in their own calendar. The event subject is deterministic and includes a scenario-correlation token. The event is private to test-user-01; no attendees are added.
correlation_strategy: Event subject carries the scenario-correlation token.
notes: Calendars.ReadWrite is required because the scenario creates events. Calendars.Read alone is insufficient. AUTO_CLEANUP_SUPPORTED indicates that a paired SCN-CALENDAR-003 cleanup scenario can remove the event.
